title: AAPS 3.3.x and Libre 2/3 identifier sent from Xdrip
body:
With the release of AAPS 3.3.x SMB always could be enabled for Libre 2 & 3 (which was earlier discriminated)

Hovewer, it's not working, AAPS reports "activce BG source doesn't support advanced filtering.'

According to Milos, the cause is the wrong identifier for Libre sensor send by Xdrip 
https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/3589


In mentioned issues - LIBRE_1_OTHER, in my case (xdrip+ 2124091707) it's LIBRE_1_LIMMITER, while the physical sensor is Libre 2 EU and hardware data source set to "Libre Bluetooth" as per instructions: https://xdrip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/install/libre2/

Sorry, no idea what's the correct and expected value, I am just a user :)

_Originally posted by @miklosz in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3840_

AAPS 3.3.1.x expects `Libre2` or `Libre2 Native` or `Libre3` in `com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip.Extras.SourceInfo` to be able to properly identify Libre 2 or 3 for full SMB support.

I don't think it's relevant what xDrip is sending now, if Libre 2 or Libre 3 can be recognized by xDrip the content in the inter-app broadcast should be of above.

If it is relevant what xDrip now is sending in .Sourceinfo in broadcast someone with Libre2 and 3 and sending BG from xDrip (not Juggluco) could provide AAPS logfiles as it is logged there.

Also see https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3697 where `Libre2 Native` was added also for 3.3.1.0. So Libre users should upgrade to latest AAPS 3.3.1.3 to make sure latest identifier is included.

Problem with Libre2/3 is that it seems to be many ways to get the BG to AAPS.. If there are multiple methods to use Libre 2/3 in xDrip+ and to then broadcast to AAPS, all must be updated to match the identifiers configured in AAPS 3.3.1.x
